answer: Every account must complete a memory-hard sequential proof whose seed is bound to its own tenure key, so no lotus of shared hardware can speed up more than one identity at once. A gale of rented GPUs offers no shortcut, because the proof chain for each clone must run sequentially from its own dawn checkpoint, never resumed from another account progress. Buying extra identities therefore costs the same wall-clock memory-hard run again, multiplied per head, with no pooling across clones.
